text.content:
Trigger: Prolonged thaumaturgical study of blood's subtleties, or repeated tasting of exotic or supernatural vitae.

A cryptophage becomes fixated on the pursuit of ever-rarer flavors of blood, whether the vintages of specific Kindred bloodlines, the tang of Lupine or faerie vitae, or worse. The obsession is psychological rather than physical — a cryptophage can still subsist on human or animal blood, and will drink whatever's available in a frenzy — but common fare grows increasingly repugnant, sometimes requiring a Willpower expenditure (System) or Willpower Trait (MET) just to keep it down without complaint.

Left unchecked, the character pursues supernatural prey for their blood with reckless disregard for danger, sometimes even opening her own veins to heighten the contrast and appreciation of a rarer vintage immediately after. As with other derangements, spending a Willpower point (System) or Trait (MET) allows a moment of clarity to resist the compulsion for a scene, though the craving persists until treated through extended roleplaying resolution.

Also listed for Storytellers under Rules Reference (Storyteller Only): @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.28151a666f1c4a15]{Sanguinary Cryptophagy} (same write-up, kept there too for topical browsing).
